descriptions.d24l_property_value_802aa5f0: Takes a String by value (destroyed before returning) and looks it up as a property into a handle (0x800fc1b0). Kind 0 (virtual slot +24) returns 0x80178c48 of the cast 0x803426b4, kind 1 returns 0x80178d1c of the cast 0x80342a78. An empty name, a failed lookup or any other kind returns 0; the last two also make and drop a temporary copy of the name.
